description: This file defines a Java enum 'FileLog' responsible for managing log files, including creating log files, writing log lines with timestamps, handling exceptions, and closing logs. It includes logging methods, file handling utilities, and a Logger implementation.

classes.name: FileLog
classes.description: An enum managing log file creation, writing log entries with timestamps, handling exceptions, and file closing. Provides static methods for log file management and an internal Logger implementation for info and error logging.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the log file output stream if not already opened.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Creates a new log file with a timestamp in its name and returns a FileOutputStream for it.

methods.name: createFolderIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates the logs directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns a timestamp string formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH_mm_ss'.

methods.name: logLine
methods.description: Logs a line with a timestamp prefix to stdout and the log file, unless logging is suspended.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the active log file stream if open.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs an exception's stack trace to the log file.

methods.name: logException
methods.description: Logs a message and exception details, including stack trace.
